review_improvement: Prevents hard-coded buddy values from being treated as universal, binds the destructive target to an attested chip-select decode and preserves the source reverse-sparing coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Striking the buddy rank within the protected bank makes the current replacement unsafe, so BIOS must reverse or reassign that pairing before establishing the second region. That causal path is different from simply adding a region on the failed rank. The complete before/after failed/buddy map and pinned allocation order are therefore the oracle; the corrected-error logs and transient copy bit alone cannot prove safe re-pairing.
